title: Use Seedance 2 “video ref” for motion capture, then add text prompts to…
content: Use Seedance 2 “video ref” for motion capture, then add text prompts to intentionally deviate from the reference while still following it in a general sense.
tips: Use Seedance 2 “video ref” for motion capture, then add text prompts to intentionally deviate from the reference while still following it in a general sense.

es.content: Usa Seedance 2 “video ref” para captura de movimiento, y luego añade prompts de texto para desviarte intencionalmente de la referencia, aunque siguiéndola en un sentido general.

fr.content: Utilisez « video ref » de Seedance 2 pour la capture de mouvement, puis ajoutez des prompts textuels afin de vous écarter intentionnellement de la référence tout en la suivant dans un sens général.

ja.content: Seedance 2 の「video ref」をモーションキャプチャに使用し、その後に text prompt を追加して、参照から意図的に逸脱しつつも、全体としてはそれに従うようにします。

ko.content: Seedance 2의 “video ref”를 모션 캡처에 사용한 다음, 텍스트 prompt를 추가해 레퍼런스에서 의도적으로 벗어나되, 전체적으로는 여전히 이를 따르도록 합니다.

pt.content: Use o “video ref” do Seedance 2 para captura de movimento e, em seguida, adicione prompts de texto para se desviar intencionalmente da referência, mantendo ainda assim uma aderência geral a ela.

zh.content: 使用 Seedance 2 的“video ref”进行动作捕捉，然后添加文本 prompt，故意偏离参考内容，同时在整体上仍保持对其的遵循。
